headline: Diwali Sunday looks strong: Ramayana and Jailer 2 are expected to rise tomorrow, while Aadarsha Kutumbam eases.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana could sell about 79.7K tickets in the 9–10 PM hour (range 65.5K–94K), taking today's projection to about 1.26M (range 1.20M–1.31M).
Tomorrow, Ramayana is forecast at about 1.46M tickets (range 1.24M–1.61M), helped by Diwali tomorrow and its opening-weekend phase.
Jailer 2 is expected to peak at about 1.6K in the 9–10 PM hour, with today's total near 25.4K (range 24.3K–26.5K) and tomorrow near 26.7K (range 22.8K–29.5K).
Aadarsha Kutumbam is expected to peak at about 1.9K in the 8–9 PM hour (range 1.6K–2.1K), then ease to about 1.3K by 10–11 PM.
watch: Ramayana's word of mouth is mixed, so its signal adds nothing, and its ratings-based lift of 10% could fade if reviews turn negative.
The Diwali boost is an assumption; if tomorrow's crowds fall short of the usual Sunday pattern, the Ramayana and Jailer 2 ranges could tighten toward their lower ends.
